response.sql: WITH per_day_by_film AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate / rental_duration AS per_day_price FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL), per_day_by_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(per_day_price) AS avg_per_day FROM per_day_by_film GROUP BY rating), across_rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM per_day_by_rating), kept_ratings AS (SELECT avg_per_day, avg_per_day - (SELECT overall_avg FROM across_rating_average) AS excess FROM per_day_by_rating WHERE avg_per_day > (SELECT overall_avg FROM across_rating_average)) SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS avg_kept_per_day, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept_ratings;

assumptions.assumption: Per-day rental price is computed as rental_rate ÷ rental_duration for each film, then averaged within each rating
The across-rating average is a simple arithmetic mean of per-rating averages, not a weighted average by film count per rating
